text: 中国PMI与美国非农先后出炉；沃勒就通胀前景发言；特斯拉Cybercab发布；黄仁勋与马斯克等出席G20科技部长会议；贝森特或在G20警告各国配合对伊经济制裁；电子元器件涨价潮延续；苹果CEO交接；Shein港股上市同步落地。 <u>8月31日(周一)：</u> 09:30 中国8月官方制造业PMI 智谱等33只中国股票正式纳入MSCI指数； G20财长和央行行长会议，贝森特或警告各国配合对伊经济制裁。 <u>9月1日(周二)：</u> 08:00 韩国8月出口 09:45 中国8月RatingDog制造业PMI 16:00 欧元区8月制造业PMI终值
text_en: China PMI and US nonfarm payrolls due out in succession; Waller to speak on inflation outlook; Tesla Cybercab unveiled; Huang Renxun and Musk attend G20 tech ministers meeting; Bessent may warn nations at G20 to cooperate with Iran sanctions; electronic component price hikes continue; Apple CEO transition; Shein Hong Kong listing to land simultaneously. <u>Monday, Aug 31:</u> 09:30 China August official manufacturing PMI; 33 Chinese stocks including Zhipu officially included in MSCI index; G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting, Bessent may warn nations to cooperate with Iran sanctions. <u>Tuesday, Sep 1:</u> 08:00 South Korea August exports; 09:45 China August RatingDog manufacturing PMI; 16:00 Eurozone August manufacturing PMI final.
